$comment: First Words (Q0.8): two fittings on the ship's rail, the speaking tube (to the crew) and the hatch (to the engine room). For the Copilot app course, the Prompt Box and Terminal: speaking the course's first prompt into one of them answers the quiz (the right tool is the tube). {prompt} is the prompt.
prompt: Give me an overview of the copilot-app-for-beginners course repository…

lines.text: This course has eight chapters, from 00 Setup to 07 Automations.
Learning path: Setup → Tour the App → Sessions, Worktrees, and Context → Development and GitHub Workflows → Skills and Custom Agents → MCP Servers and Plugins → Canvases → Automations.
samples/book-app-web is the web sample you’ll use in later exercises.

text.finishWithJuno: Talk to Juno to finish up at the ship.
text.hint1: Is this a command to run, or a request for the agent?
text.hint2: Requests to the agent go in the prompt box. That’s the brass speaking tube.
text.hint3: I’ve spoken it into the Prompt Box for you. Listen.
